image.note: LoadImage expects a filename inside the ComfyUI input folder (upload first). Image 1: the reference to recreate; feeds ImageResizeKJv2 30 -> VAEEncode 7 -> ReferenceLatent 8 (with prompt 13), GetImageSize 9 -> EmptyLatentImage 10, and the comparer 3. One image per run: the runner loops when the node fans out (`each`).

prompt.note: Default 'Remove and replace the head and hair in the image 1, keep everything else consistent ...' plus a character description. Describe the character here; the LoRA carries the identity.

negative.note: Empty by default; feeds KSampler 31 negative.

count.note: Width and height are wired from GetImageSize 9; only batch_size is a free widget.

image.note: No SaveImage in this workflow; node 2 previews the decoded result (temp/). PreviewImage 1 is the stitched before/after strip. Runner fetches via /view?type=temp or a human swaps in SaveImage.

notes: The character is a trained LoRA (LoraLoaderModelOnly 26, Lora_lora_000000500.safetensors) plus a second reference LoadImage 16 -> VAEEncode 6 -> ReferenceLatent 5. Neither is a studio port of this kind: set the LoRA name and the character shot by hand on the pod, or through a RefMod/LoRA step, before running.

Parameter `mode: batch` names the sibling workflow icekiub/Image_to_image_Klein_edit_-_batch_-_Icekiub_v1.5.json, which replaces LoadImage 11 with LoadImageListFromDir //Inspire 33 (a folder path on the pod's disk). The engine binds this single-image file and loops per item instead, so the item list, seeds and manifests stay under the runner's control.
The catalogue marks this node adult: true (Icekiub pack); it needs review before it is offered generally.

Consent step: the runner refuses to run it unless every reference collection feeding it has collection.json with rights owned, licensed or fictional, and consent: true for a real person (docs/engine/BATCHES.md).
